name: NVIDIA

eyebrow.en: NVIDIA Corporation · Common stock · Santa Clara, California
eyebrow.zh: 英伟达 · 普通股 · 加州圣克拉拉

title.en: The AI build-out, one quarter at a time.
title.zh: AI 建设浪潮，一季接一季。

lede.en: Revenue doubled to $96.2B last quarter, $89B of it from data centers, and Nvidia guides to $108B next, its first $100B+ quarter, without any China data center sales. The watch points are margins, squeezed by soaring memory prices, and cash: customers are getting longer to pay.
lede.zh: 上季营收翻倍至 962 亿美元，其中 890 亿来自数据中心；下季指引 1080 亿，将首次突破 1000 亿，且未计入任何中国数据中心收入。需关注的是被内存涨价挤压的毛利率，以及客户付款周期拉长带来的现金流变化。

s.zh: FY27 第三季 · 预计，盘后

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. Nvidia ranged between about $164 and $243 over the past year.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。过去一年股价在约 $164 至 $243 间。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with gross margin on the right axis. Nvidia's fiscal year ends in late January; Q2 FY27 ended July 26, 2026. Q1 FY26's 60.5% margin includes an H20 inventory charge. The last bar is guidance at the midpoint.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为毛利率。英伟达财年于1月下旬结束；FY27 第二季截至 2026年7月26日。FY26 第一季 60.5% 的毛利率含 H20 库存减值。最后一根柱为指引中值。

s.zh: 同比 +106% · 连续第13季创纪录
Q2 回购 200 亿 + 股息 60 亿

p.en: Q3 is guided to $108B, and Vera Rubin should be about 20% of data center revenue in Q3, with hyperscale growth re-accelerating in Q4.
p.zh: Q3 指引 1080 亿美元，Vera Rubin 预计占 Q3 数据中心收入约 20%，云厂商需求将于 Q4 再度加速。

p.en: Management says memory prices rose more than expected. Gross margin is guided to 74% in Q3 and 71–72% in Q4 before price increases restore 72–73% in FY28.
p.zh: 管理层称内存涨幅超预期。毛利率 Q3 指引 74%，Q4 为 71–72%，提价后 FY28 回到 72–73%。

p.en: Days sales outstanding rose to 60 as Nvidia gave big customers longer to pay, and inventory reached $32B ahead of Vera Rubin. Free cash flow fell to $21.4B from $48.6B.
p.zh: 英伟达给予大客户更长付款期，应收账款天数升至 60 天，库存为 Vera Rubin 增至 320 亿美元。自由现金流由 486 亿降至 214 亿。

p.en: Guidance assumes no China data center compute revenue. A handful of hyperscalers and AI labs buy most of the output.
p.zh: 指引未计入中国数据中心算力收入。大部分产品由少数云厂商与 AI 实验室采购。
指引：营收 1080 亿美元 ±2%，毛利率 74%。

p.en: Management expects gross margin to bottom at 71–72% before price increases take effect.
p.zh: 管理层预计毛利率在 71–72% 见底，之后提价生效。

h.zh: 第四季及 FY27 业绩

sources: Q2 FY27 results and Q3 guidance
Q2 FY27 call: margins, DSO, returns
Price, market cap, beta and earnings date: Financial Modeling Prep, as of Oct 9, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Oct 9, 2026. For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with NVIDIA Corporation.
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年10月9日。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 NVIDIA Corporation 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q3 FY22 to Q2 FY27. Nvidia's fiscal year ends in late January. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 FY22 第三季至 FY27 第二季共 20 个季度。英伟达财年于1月下旬结束。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

read.en: Nvidia barely needs capex, so free cash flow tracks operating cash: it went from about $1–3B a quarter in 2022 to $48.6B in Q1 FY27. Q2 dropped to $21.4B even though profit rose, because Nvidia extended payment terms for big customers and built $32B of inventory for Vera Rubin.
read.zh: 英伟达资本开支很小，自由现金流基本等于经营现金流：由 2022 年每季约 10–30 亿美元增至 FY27 第一季的 486 亿。第二季利润增长但自由现金流降至 214 亿，原因是给予大客户更长付款期，并为 Vera Rubin 备货 320 亿库存。

read.en: With $108B of revenue guided for Q3 and roughly 60% net margins, I assume much of the working-capital build unwinds over the next year, giving $42–61B a quarter and about $212B over four quarters. Most of that goes back to shareholders: $26B was returned in Q2 alone.
read.zh: Q3 营收指引 1080 亿美元、净利率约 60%，我假设营运资金占用在未来一年逐步回落，每季自由现金流 420–610 亿，四季合计约 2120 亿。其中大部分回馈股东：仅 Q2 就回馈 260 亿。

p.en: $20B of buybacks and $6B of dividends in Q2; the quarterly dividend is now $0.25 a share.
p.zh: Q2 回购 200 亿美元、派息 60 亿；季度股息现为每股 $0.25。

p.en: Receivables at 60 days and $32B of inventory tie up cash ahead of the Vera Rubin ramp.
p.zh: 60 天应收账款与 320 亿库存在 Vera Rubin 放量前占用现金。

p.en: $15.8B of equity securities bought in Q2, up from $0.3B a year earlier.
p.zh: Q2 购入股权证券 158 亿美元，一年前为 3 亿。

p.en: $89B in Q2, with Q3 guided to $108B in total revenue.
p.zh: Q2 数据中心 890 亿美元，Q3 总营收指引 1080 亿。

p.en: Nvidia borrowed about $25B in the quarter, adding to its cash cushion.
p.zh: 本季举债约 250 亿美元，增厚现金。

bridgeNote.en: Excludes strategic investments and debt flows.
bridgeNote.zh: 未计入战略投资与债务变动。
